records.title: AdaptInfer: Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language Model Inference via Dynamical Text Guidance
records.reason: AdaptInferはtext-token重要度からvision tokenを層ごとにpruneし、VLMのprefill vision-token処理を削減する。Qwen2-VLで要旨は約70%のprefill overhead減を報告する。

records.title: SSD: Spatial-Semantic Head Decoupling for Efficient Autoregressive Image Generation
records.reason: 対象はautoregressive画像生成のvisual token cacheで、視覚品質を保ちながら画像生成memory/throughputを改善する。要旨にLLM推論・servingへの具体的適用は示されない。

records.title: DeltaLLM: Compress LLMs with Low-Rank Deltas between Shared Weights
records.reason: DeltaLLMはTransformer block間のweight sharingとlow-rank差分でLLM parameter数・保存量を圧縮し、基礎モデルに近い評価性能を保つ。

records.title: QubitCache: Quantum-Inspired Probabilistic Attention Preservation for KV-Cache Compression
records.reason: The institutional article record ties the exact IEEE DOI and title to the authors, IEEE Access volume 14, pages 56679-56693, and an abstract describing attention-distribution compression of KV cache, 6.7x memory reduction, and decode overhead within 2x of eviction methods. No primary metadata directly links the separate anonymized OpenReview submission to this DOI, so the DOI remains the canonical resolved ID.

records.title: Attention Condensation via Sparsity Induced Regularized Training
records.reason: 要旨のattention sparsity制約はLLMの推論時attention計算を直接減らす提案なので関連性はaccept。arXivはwithdrawnと損失式の訂正・再実験予定を明記するため、実験主張の信頼性は別途要確認。

records.title: SPECS: Faster Test-Time Scaling Through Speculative Drafts and Dynamic Switching
records.reason: SPECS uses smaller speculative drafts, reward-guided verification, and dynamic switching to reduce user-facing LLM reasoning latency.

records.title: MegaFold: Efficient Training of Next-Generation 3D Attention Protein Models on Cross-Platform GPUs
records.reason: MegaFoldはAlphaFold3型の3D attentionを使う蛋白質モデルの学習GPU utilizationを改善するが、要旨自身がLLM trainingと異なるworkloadとして区別し、LLMシステム効率への直接接続を示さない。
